links.comparator_used: Basic prompt and Iterative prompt (no grade-level or metric instructions) for LLM-generated materials, with existing institutional materials as the baseline
links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level, Modified Grade Level, Reading Ease) of LLM-generated colorectal patient education materials
links.effect: ChatGPT with Metric-based prompt vs baseline: Grade Level 5.2 vs 8.1, Modified Grade Level 7.3 vs 10.3, Ease 70.5 vs 60.4, all P < .01. Perplexity with Metric-based prompt did not differ statistically from baseline, whereas Perplexity's other prompts were significantly less readable. Direct Metric-vs-Basic numbers were not given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: LLM-generated documents were much shorter than existing materials (170-313 words vs 863-956), which may mean less content. Most LLM output from non-metric prompts did not meet readability recommendations.
links.quote: Overall, ChatGPT materials were more readable than baseline materials with the Metric-based prompt: Grade Level 5.2 vs 8.1, Modified Grade Level 7.3 vs 10.3, and Ease 70.5 vs 60.4, all P < .01.

design_hint: reading-level constraints via metric-based prompt engineering
